ev.q: During the second quarter of 2020, the number of deaths reported with gabapentin detected (959) approximately doubled compared with the first quarter of 2019 (449)
this percentage increased to 55.1% during the fourth quarter of 2020
in the fourth quarter of 2020, 801 deaths with gabapentin detected occurred
declined from 41.9% of deaths with gabapentin detected in the first quarter of 2019 to 33.0%
State Unintentional Drug Overdose Reporting System (SUDORS)
To assess quarterly trends in gabapentin-involved overdose deaths

methods_quotes.q: SUDORS requires jurisdictions to abstract data from death certificates and medical examiner or coroner reports, including postmortem toxicology results
all drugs detected in postmortem toxicology were included as involved in the death
Data are reported to SUDORS in half-year increments (January–June and July–December) based on when deaths occur.
among 58,362 deaths with documented toxicology results, a total of 5,687 (9.7%) had gabapentin detected
